pieces.body:
ENV-2 Docker engine: Docker is installed but its daemon is not running
Docker API version: the daemon did not answer, so neither version could be read
Docker Compose: the Compose plugin reported a version that could not be read
OrbStack network bridge: the stack's engine is not OrbStack
The stack comes back after a restart: disabled: starting on boot was not asked for, so nothing here is expected to bring the stack back
Where the stack is actually listening: nothing in this stack is publishing a port, so there is no binding to check — start it and ask again
Hardlinks: ext4, 2 names to one file
Storage mode: local — imports hardlink instantly
Free space: 3.0 TiB free of 4.0 TiB
Service access: Docker maps file ownership on this platform, so the host's permissions do not gate the services
One mount beneath the data location: neither the project nor your overlay gives a service two mounts beneath the data location, so imports inside the containers link rather than copy
VPN verification: torrent downloads are not configured
Indexer credential: no indexer is configured, so there is none to prove
Providers: there are no accounts in use to read — no Usenet account the download client is pulling through, and no indexer being queried
Quality guide source: the quality guide source could not be confirmed reachable, so whether the profiles can stay current is unknown: connection refused
Room for the chosen quality: the free space holds about 1319 hours of content at the balanced preset
Releases for the chosen quality: no television, film or music service is configured, so there are no releases to check
Every series opens onto its seasons: the media server could not be reached
What the household is told: this stack has no request service, so there is nothing to ask and nobody asking
Who holds each service claimed first: no service here belongs to whoever claims it first
What the request gate refused and removed: the request gate cannot be asked over its contract, so what it refused cannot be read
What the decline service's key was used for: there is no media server to ask, or it cannot be asked over its contracts, so when the decline service's key was last used cannot be read
What the media server holds under the stack's services' names: Jellyfin could not be reached
How the request service is linked to Plex: Plex is not the media server the request service reaches through the request gate
PLUGIN-42 Parts this release runs as plugins: Moving jellyfin, prowlarr, qbittorrent, radarr, sonarr onto its plugin is on offer
SETTING-8 Services waiting for what only you can give: gluetun, qbittorrent are held back until you give what they need to start
Credential files readable only by you: none of the files lemonfiber keeps credentials in is on this machine yet, so there are no permissions to read
The operator's overlay: no overlay is merged over the project
